content:
Hi all! I've been a huge fan of lean.nvim for a while, so I ported it to vim which is my preferred editor for a much longer time. I hope some other unwilling neovim adopters get some usage out of this: https://github.com/SamuelSchlesinger/lean.vim. I'm the only one who has used it so far, so please expect some rough edges and report issues upstream.

The features aren't entirely aligned with lean.nvim for reasons ranging from editor differences to taste differences. Enjoy!
